name: Cosima Farfali from the Farfali House
source: Cosima Farfali has a secret, she is a manasi, a human capable of magic. When she leaves for college she encounters a friend of her father, who gets her involved in a ritual where she has to fight for her life alongside Eloisa Cobossi, a mage from 200 years ago, at the same time she discovers the secrets of her family and her existence.
translation: 科西玛·法法莉有一个秘密，她是玛纳西，一个会魔法的人类。当她去上大学时，她遇到了父亲的一个朋友，父亲让她参与了一个仪式，她必须与200年前的法师埃洛伊萨·科博西 (Eloisa Cobossi) 一起为自己的生命而战，同时她发现了家人和自己存在的秘密。
